5.   City Council Action Required


     A.   ORDINANCE 84-2024-25 (First Reading) An Ordinance of the City of Clarksville,
          Tennessee amending City Code Title 10 (Offenses - Miscellaneous), Chapter 1
          (Generally), Section 10-101 (Certain Misdemeaners Under State Law), to adopt by
          reference state traffic offenses, rules of the road, and certain other
          misdemeanors Councilman Deanna McLaughlin, Public Safety Committee:
          Approval

                 Councilman McLaughlin made a motion to approve ORDINANCE 84-2024-25
                 (First Reading). Coiuncilman Zacharias seconded the motion. Councilman
                 Streetman then made a motion to postpone this item until the July Finance
                 Committee meeting. Councilman Zacharias seconded the motion. A voice vote
                 was taken and the motion to postpone passed.
     B.   RESOLUTION 59-2024-25 A Resolution of the City Council of the City of
          Clarksville, Tennessee to approve issuance of tax-exempt revenue bonds or other
          tax-exempt debt by the Health and Educational Facilities Board of the Metropolitan
          Government of Nashville and Davidson County, Tennessee for the benefit of
          Vanderbilt University Medical Center

                 Councilman Lovato made a motion to adopt Resolution 59-23024-
                 25. Councilman Shakeenab seconded the motion. A voice vote was taken and
                 the motion passed.
     C.   RESOLUTION 60-2024-25 A Resolution appointing an Interim Director of Finance
          for the City of Clarksville

                 Councilman Lovato made a motion to adopt RESOLUTION 60-2024-25.
                 Councilman Zacharias seconded the motion. A voice vote was taken and the
                 motion passed.
